knowledge_point.title: Identifying the Shift Applied to an Exponential Growth Curve

question.:question/problem:
![](images/b8/b8d4f8b64ed80003c9d1c42cc8a71e03cb2425cc34b7d8b900de529db5df4986.png)

The graph above shows the curve $y={22}^{x}+c.$ Determine the value of $c$ and find the equation of the curve.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The horizontal asymptote of $y={22}^{x}$ is $y=0.$ The vertical translation $y={22}^{x}+c$ shifts the asymptote to $y=c.$

In the graph above, the horizontal asymptote is $y=-7.$ Therefore, $c=-7.$
